name: Warthog Rally
summary:
Start your engines! Prove your driving skills and win trophies in every race track! Unlock all 15 vehicles and customize your experience to your liking!
Warthog Rally is a campaign mod that let's you race against the time to win trophies. You will unlock more vehicles as you win trophies. You can also choose to spawn in a bunch of enemies and add some passengers in your vehicle.
